description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kamburugamuwa North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820069
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
